capabilities: Mirrors each BlackOps brain into its own folder inside one vault folder
Uploads local edits about 5 seconds after typing stops and on app close
Downloads changes on open, on return, every minute, and via Sync now command or ribbon button
Creates, renames and archives notes in BlackOps when files are added, renamed or deleted
Merges non-overlapping simultaneous edits and saves conflicting copies as separate files
extras: Only touches files inside the BlackOps folder; brains synced with GitHub are left alone; adds the BlackOps folder and its settings folder to .gitignore; sign-in secret is kept in app local storage, not in notes or data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep notes in sync with a BlackOps Center brain, so edits made in either place stay separate.
summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors BlackOps Center brain notes with a folder in your Obsidian vault.
